camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-access-monitor --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Modifies the access tracking status of a bucket
description_zh: 修改存储空间（Bucket）的访问追踪状态
name: PutBucketAccessMonitor

fields.help_en:
The access tracking status of the bucket. Valid values:

- Enabled: enabled
- Disabled: disabled
fields.help_zh:
Bucket的访问跟踪状态。取值范围如下：

- Enabled：已开启

- Disabled：未开启
fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The container that stores the access tracking status configuration of the bucket
parameters.help_zh: 保存Bucket的访问跟踪状态配置信息的容器
parameters.name: access_monitor_configuration

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for modifying the access tracking status configuration
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 修改访问跟踪状态配置的请求体
v1_body_parameters.name: body
